name: revyl
description: Open your app's Revyl Atlas map and live cloud iOS, Android and web sessions in a Revyl panel beside your code and inside GitHub Copilot Chat, through Revyl's hosted MCP server. macOS computers open in your browser. Sign in with your Revyl account on first use; no API key or local install needed.

languageModelTools.name: revyl_open_panel
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open Revyl Atlas or a device session in an editor tab beside the code.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Opens or focuses the Revyl panel, an editor tab beside the code that shows Revyl Atlas or a live device session. Use it when the user asks to open Revyl, Atlas, or a device session in a panel, tab, or beside the code. Empty input opens Atlas. It never starts a device session: pass session_id only for a session that already runs.

view.description: View to open: atlas or device. Defaults to device when session_id is given, else atlas.

app_id.description: App UUID, for the atlas view only.

session_id.description: Running device session UUID, for the device view only. Without it the device view lists sessions.
